original: De Scheelhoek is een natuurgebied op het eiland Goeree-Overflakkee, in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland. translated: The Scheelhoek is a nature reserve on the island of Goeree-Overflakkee, in the Dutch province of South Holland. This bird reserve is located on the edge of Stellendam, between the Zuiderdiep and the Haringvliet. The area of 343 hectares is managed by Natural Monuments. It consists of the Plate of Scheelhoek with creeks, reed and grasslands and the Scheelhoekbos.
